title: Tour the Information tab
summary: The patient's details, notes and preferences, sub-tab by sub-tab.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Information
steps.details: Personal details, internal notes and preferences.

steps.title: Details
steps.details: Form with name, contact, ID, mutual society, default doctor, dependent and responsible contact. It's edited and saved here.

steps.title: Patient details
steps.details: Change what you need and save with «Save changes».

steps.title: Notes
steps.details: Internal notes for the team, not clinical.

steps.title: Preferences
steps.details: Notices they get, finance view and scheduling.

steps.title: Finance view
steps.details: Normal or Custom. Saved as soon as you tap it.
